predict.question: Your inbox filter pulls a set of messages to the top: eight you actually need and two irrelevant ones. What share of the selected messages is relevant?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Hyperfocus distinguishes directing attention intentionally from following what captures it.
modelBoundary: Salience selection contains {A}% relevant items; relevance selection {B}%. The selected mix changes; item relevance itself does not.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The supplied filter outputs are not measured human attention or proof that relevance is easy to judge.
